_about: Your own golfer. Attributes are bought with skill points, one level at a time, up to level 10. Each level adds the effects in fx. Perks switch on when an attribute reaches a level. Challenges pay skill points once each. test: a number the game tracks (see scripts/core/career.gd) that must reach at_least, or fall to at_most.

attributes.name: Power
attributes.desc: How far you hit every club.

attributes.name: Accuracy
attributes.desc: How straight your full shots fly.

perks.name: Wind Whisperer
perks.desc: Your aim line allows for the wind.

attributes.name: Ball Striking
attributes.desc: A slower swing meter and a bigger sweet spot.

perks.name: Pure
perks.desc: You no longer chunk shots from the fairway or tee.

perks.name: Flop Shot
perks.desc: Unlocks the flop: high, soft and short.

attributes.name: Putting
attributes.desc: Putts start closer to your line.

perks.name: Green Reader
perks.desc: Your putting line shows the break.

perks.name: Clutch
perks.desc: The hole plays a quarter wider for you.

attributes.name: Recovery
attributes.desc: Less distance lost from rough, sand and wet ground.

perks.name: Escape Artist
perks.desc: Rough costs you a good deal less again.

attributes.name: Spin
attributes.desc: The ball checks up harder on the green, and you learn to shape shots.

perks.name: Shot Shaper
perks.desc: Unlocks the draw and the fade. Bend the ball round trouble.

perks.name: Spin Doctor
perks.desc: Unlocks the high backspin shot, which stops dead.

attributes.name: Luck
attributes.desc: Your ball finds a way through trees more often.

perks.name: Lip In
perks.desc: Putts that catch the edge drop.
